# A Jew — Breslov Torah Library

> The largest online Breslov Torah library. 226+ sacred Jewish texts, 25,000+ pages in Hebrew with English translations. Free and open to all.

**URL:** https://ajew.org
**Languages:** English, Hebrew (bilingual)
**RSS:** https://ajew.org/rss.xml
**Sitemap:** https://ajew.org/sitemap-index.xml

## Key Sections

- **Library** — https://ajew.org/reader — Full text library of 226+ Jewish texts (Likutay Moharan, Zohar, Talmud, Mishna, Rambam, Tanach, and more)
- **Daily Study** — https://ajew.org/daily-study — Structured daily learning schedule
- **Search** — https://ajew.org/search-enhanced — Full-text search across 26,510+ pages
- **Topics** — https://ajew.org/topics — Browse by topic: Emunah, Tefillah, Teshuvah, Simcha, Shalom, Parnassah, Healing, Shmiras HaBris, Hisbodedus
- **Reference** — https://ajew.org/reference — Citation and cross-reference tools
- **Parsha** — https://ajew.org/parsha — Weekly Torah portion insights
- **Healing Words** — https://ajew.org/healing-words — Breslov teachings on healing and hope
- **Torah GPS** — https://ajew.org/torah-gps — Guided spiritual navigation through Torah
- **Torah Lens** — https://ajew.org/torah-lens — Torah perspectives on current topics
- **Chain of Light** — https://ajew.org/chain-of-light — Breslov lineage and transmission chain
- **Saba Says** — https://ajew.org/saba-says — Wisdom of Rabbi Yisroel Ber Odesser (the Saba)
- **Chat** — https://ajew.org/chat — AI-assisted Torah Q&A
- **Blog** — https://ajew.org/blog
- **Gematria** — https://ajew.org/gematria
- **Gallery** — https://ajew.org/gallery — Visual Torah
- **Ramchal** — https://ajew.org/ramchal — Writings of Rabbi Moshe Chaim Luzzatto
- **About** — https://ajew.org/about

## Key Texts in the Library

The site hosts complete, searchable editions of:
- Likutay Moharan (Rabbi Nachman's magnum opus, 411 teachings)
- Likutay Halachos (Rabbi Nosson's halachic commentary)
- Likutay Tefilos (Rabbi Nosson's prayers)
- Sipuray Ma'asiyos (Rabbi Nachman's Stories)
- Zohar (all 8 volumes, 1,930 pages)
- Talmud Bavli (39 tractates, 5,400 dapim)
- Mishna (all 6 orders)
- Rambam — Mishneh Torah (14 books, 15,000+ halachot)
- Shulchan Aruch
- Tanach (all 24 books with nikud)
- Writings of the Ramchal (Rabbi Moshe Chaim Luzzatto)
- 47+ Breslov classics
- And many more

## Technical

- Built with Astro (static site generation)
- Deployed on Vercel
- Schema.org structured data on all pages (WebSite, Organization, BreadcrumbList)
- Open Graph and Twitter Card support
- Full-text search via Supabase (23,590 documents indexed)
- RSS feed for updates
- Bilingual (English + Hebrew) with hreflang alternates
